summary: Whether you show it or not, an appetite for more and a need to believe in something and a longing for something more and a soft, porous edge flow together so easily you can take it for granted. It comes naturally — you reach, grow, and lift the room and you imagine, feel for others, and create — which is exactly why it's easy to coast on.
